precondition: FrameItem::Line has a carried LineCap, matrix auto/custom producers select Square/resolved cap, legacy producers select Butt, and mechanical reconstruction preserves cap

variants.transform: remove/reset cap while reconstructing a FrameItem::Line
matrix auto augment emits Butt instead of Square
replace resolved custom Round/Butt with Square
representative fraction rule emits Square instead of Butt
an allowlisted mechanical reconstruction resets a carried non-Butt cap to Butt

validity: Each variant needs a direct full-frame cap witness. Raster/PDF output cannot substitute for missing carrier attribution; legacy behavior must remain Butt.
